# TJ Nicolaides

TJ Nicolaides is an Engineering Manager at Airbnb based in Ardmore, PA.

## Current Role

Engineering Manager, Airbnb Friendly Apartments (AFA) — a marketplace product enabling apartment renters to host part-time on Airbnb. TJ leads a team of 7 engineers and is accountable for a platform spanning 1,300+ buildings across four countries (US, UK, Brazil, Canada), generating approximately $13M in annual host earnings.

## Background

~15 years of full-stack engineering experience across web, iOS, and Android. Backend work spans Rails, Java, Kotlin, and PHP, alongside deep frontend expertise. Engineering leader with a player-coach philosophy: staying close to the technical work, defaulting to boring technology, and preferring monolith-first architecture before reaching for distributed complexity. Focused on building high-trust, collaborative teams that can navigate a rapidly transforming field.

## Open To

Director of Engineering, Senior Engineering Manager, Tech Lead Manager, and Staff Engineer roles at high-growth technology companies, particularly in marketplace, platform, or product engineering contexts.
